digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md documentation and developer tooling guidance
propositions: AGENTS.md falsely claims LSP symbol tools are reliable for all reference finding, but they cannot resolve symbols named as string literals in monkeypatch.setattr and similar dynamic attribute access patterns
LSP indexes can lag behind recent edits in the working tree, causing reported line numbers to become stale within a single session
The current unconditional preference for LSP over grep trains agents to discount the rule when they encounter its false negatives, contributing to missed call sites
A decision table dividing labour by use case (semantic symbol queries to LSP, string-literal patterns to grep, current line numbers to working tree grep) makes the guidance safe to follow literally
The string-literal blind spot must be named explicitly with concrete examples (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) so agents understand the boundary condition
Documentation must remain lean per AGENTS.md's own standing instruction, relegating supporting evidence and reproducible checks to docs/ rather than inline expansion
